name: english-practice
description: English Practice — plataforma de práctica de inglés (módulo Writing)

scripts.dev: npm run build -w packages/shared && concurrently -n api,web -c magenta,cyan "npm run dev -w apps/api" "npm run dev -w apps/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w packages/shared && npm run build -w apps/api && npm run build -w apps/web
scripts.test: npm run test -w packages/shared && npm run test -w apps/api
